title: 星降る夜の図書室と、欠けた月の落としもの
author: 猫柳 すず

en.title: The Library of the Starry Night and the Lost Item of the Waning Moon
en.premise: I run a small business that serves as both a second-hand bookstore and a library. One night, an old celestial atlas is brought to my door. Within its pages are star charts of constellations I have never seen before, and a mysterious note arranging a meeting on the night of the next lunar eclipse. As I search for the owner, a story of a small misunderstanding from the past and a hidden act of goodwill begin to unfold, guided by the movement of the stars.

zh.title: 星降之夜的图书室与残月的遗失物
zh.premise: 我经营着一家兼作二手书店的图书室。某个夜晚，这里迎来了一本古旧的天体图鉴。图鉴的页面上，不知为何记载着从未见过的星座星图，其中还夹着一张约定在下次月食之夜见面的神秘便条。在寻找失主的过程中，隐藏在图鉴中的“某人的善意”，以及一段关于往昔小小误会的往事，将随着星辰的运行逐渐揭开。
